text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I was able to place reasonably
high, but
I'll admit I'm not quite
satisfied...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I must accept my limits as of now and
use this
result as motivation moving
forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I set out to give it my all, and I believe I
managed
to do just that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To fail despite those efforts is an
indication that I
am lacking something.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I will not dwell on this more than
necessary.
Instead, I must press forward
with my eyes on the
next target.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My goal is the peak that lies at this
path's end.
These results merely show
that I have yet to arrive
there.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Steadily and calmly, we must build on
what we
have achieved. Let us better
ourselves race by
race, Trainer.
